spec.name: pressure_5m
spec.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/secrets"



option t = secrets.get(key: "writeToken")
option v = {timeRangeStart: -5m, timeRangeStop: now(), windowPeriod: 5m}

from(bucket: "signalk_metrics")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pressure")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["environment"] != "forecast")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> set(key: "_field", value: "average")
    |> yield(name: "average")
    |> to(bucket: "signalk_data", org: "Dev-SignalK", host: "http://localhost:8086/", token: t)
from(bucket: "signalk_metrics")
    |> range(start: -1h, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pressure")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["environment"] == "forecast")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> set(key: "_field", value: "forecast")
    |> yield(name: "forecast")
    |> to(bucket: "signalk_data", org: "Dev-SignalK", host: "http://localhost:8086/", token: t)
from(bucket: "signalk_metrics")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pressure")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: min, createEmpty: false)
    |> set(key: "_field", value: "minimum")
    |> yield(name: "minimum")
    |> to(bucket: "signalk_data", org: "Dev-SignalK", host: "http://localhost:8086/", token: t)
from(bucket: "signalk_metrics")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pressure")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
    |> set(key: "_field", value: "maximum")
    |> yield(name: "maximum")
    |> to(bucket: "signalk_data", org: "Dev-SignalK", host: "http://localhost:8086/", token: t)
